@router.get("/features/{flag_key}/evaluate")
async def evaluate_feature_flag(
    flag_key: str,
    request: Request,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    eval_user_key = request.headers.get("X-Target-User-Key", str(current_user.id))
    eval_tier = request.headers.get("X-Target-Tier", current_user.subscription_tier)

    context = (
        Context.builder(eval_user_key)
        .kind("user")
        .set("tier", eval_tier)
        .set("email", current_user.email)
        .build()
    )
    is_enabled = ldclient.get().variation(flag_key, context, default=False)
    return {"flag": flag_key, "enabled": is_enabled, "user_key": eval_user_key}
diagnosis: The feature flag evaluation endpoint trusts client-supplied headers X-Target-User-Key and X-Target-Tier to construct the LaunchDarkly evaluation context instead of current_user's verified identity and tier. An attacker can set arbitrary user keys and tiers to evaluate and unlock restricted premium flags and beta feature gates.

@router.get("/features/{flag_key}/evaluate")
async def evaluate_feature_flag(
    flag_key: str,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    context = (
        Context.builder(str(current_user.id))
        .kind("user")
        .set("tier", current_user.subscription_tier)
        .set("email", current_user.email)
        .build()
    )
    is_enabled = ldclient.get().variation(flag_key, context, default=False)
    return {"flag": flag_key, "enabled": is_enabled, "user_key": str(current_user.id)}
